svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Parcelpoint's containers
svg.desc: Parcelpoint's containers: container view, 13 elements, 2 boundaries, 16 relationships. The containers of Parcelpoint and what they talk to, imported from the Structurizr workspace Parcelpoint. Elements: - Customer, external person (Waits for a parcel.) - Carriers, external system (Collect and deliver parcels, and report each scan.) - Email service, external system (Sends tracking updates.) - Boundary: Parcelpoint, enterprise - Merchant, person (Ships goods to customers.) - Support agent, person (Answers where a parcel is.) - Boundary: Parcelpoint, software system - Merchant dashboard, container, React (Creates shipments and prints labels.) - Tracking API, container, TypeScript (Shipments, parcels, and their events over HTTPS. Holds 4 components.) - Carrier event worker, container, TypeScript (Moves each parcel along as scans arrive.) - Webhook sender, container, Go (Posts parcel events to merchants' webhooks.) - Label service, container, AWS Lambda (Renders each carrier's label as a PDF.) - Tracking database, database, PostgreSQL (Merchants, shipments, parcels, and events.) - Carrier events, container, RabbitMQ (Scans waiting to be applied.) - Label PDFs, database, Amazon S3 (Every printed label, kept for a year.) Relationships: - Merchant to Merchant dashboard: Creates shipments with, HTTPS - Support agent to Merchant dashboard: Looks parcels up on, HTTPS - Customer to Tracking API: Follows a parcel on, HTTPS - Merchant dashboard to Tracking API: Creates shipments, JSON/HTTPS - Carriers to Tracking API: Reports scans, Webhooks - Tracking API to Label service: Asks for labels, HTTPS, signed - Tracking API to Carrier events: Queues scans on, AMQP - Tracking API to Tracking database: Reads and writes, SQL - Carrier event worker to Carrier events: Takes scans from, AMQP - Carrier event worker to Tracking database: Updates parcels in, SQL - Carrier event worker to Webhook sender: Hands parcel events to, AMQP - Carrier event worker to Email service: Sends updates through, HTTPS - Webhook sender to Merchant: Posts parcel events to, Webhooks - Label service to Carriers: Books labels with, HTTPS - Label service to Label PDFs: Keeps PDFs in, S3 - Email service to Customer: Emails

Holds 4 components." container worker "Carrier event worker" tech="TypeScript" desc="Moves each parcel along as scans arrive." container webhooks "Webhook sender" tech="Go" desc="Posts parcel events to merchants' webhooks." container labels "Label service" tech="AWS Lambda" desc="Renders each carrier's label as a PDF." db db_1 "Tracking database" tech="PostgreSQL" desc="Merchants, shipments, parcels, and events." container queue "Carrier events" tech="RabbitMQ" desc="Scans waiting to be applied." db labelStore "Label PDFs" tech="Amazon S3" desc="Every printed label, kept for a year." } }
system carrier "Carriers" desc="Collect and deliver parcels, and report each scan." external=on system email "Email service" desc="Sends tracking updates." external=on
merchant -> dashboard : "Creates shipments with" tech="HTTPS" support -> dashboard : "Looks parcels up on" tech="HTTPS" customer -> api : "Follows a parcel on" tech="HTTPS" dashboard -> api : "Creates shipments" tech="JSON/HTTPS" carrier -> api : "Reports scans" tech="Webhooks" api -> labels : "Asks for labels" tech="HTTPS, signed" api -> queue : "Queues scans on" tech="AMQP" api -> db_1 : "Reads and writes" tech="SQL" worker -> queue : "Takes scans from" tech="AMQP" worker -> db_1 : "Updates parcels in" tech="SQL" worker -> webhooks : "Hands parcel events to" tech="AMQP" worker -> email : "Sends updates through" tech="HTTPS" webhooks -> merchant : "Posts parcel events to" tech="Webhooks" labels -> carrier : "Books labels with" tech="HTTPS" labels -> labelStore : "Keeps PDFs in" tech="S3" email -> customer : "Emails"
